facebook-ads-management.q: Do you serve businesses outside Kuala Lumpur?
facebook-ads-management.a: Yes. We manage campaigns for clients across Malaysia — KL, Selangor, Penang, Johor Bahru, East Malaysia — and everything runs remotely via WhatsApp, video calls and a shared dashboard, so location is never a barrier.

facebook-ads-management.q: Is Facebook Ads still effective in Malaysia in 2026?

website-development.q: How much does website development cost in Malaysia?
website-development.a: Beriklan's website packages start from RM 1,499 for a professional company profile, RM 3,999 for a business website with CMS, and from RM 6,999 for custom builds or e-commerce. All packages include mobile-responsive design, SSL and basic SEO setup.

website-development.q: How long does it take to build a website?
website-development.a: A company profile site takes 2–3 weeks from brief to launch. Business sites with CMS take 3–5 weeks, and custom or e-commerce projects 6–10 weeks depending on scope. Timelines are locked in writing before the project starts.

website-development.q: Will my website be mobile-friendly and fast?
website-development.a: Yes. Over 80% of Malaysian web traffic is mobile, so we design mobile-first and build for speed — optimised images, modern frameworks and Core Web Vitals in the green. Speed is a ranking factor and a conversion factor; we treat it as non-negotiable.

website-development.q: Do you include SEO in website development?
website-development.a: Every build includes technical SEO fundamentals: clean structure, meta tags, schema markup, sitemap, fast load times and Google Search Console setup. Ongoing SEO content and link building are available separately if you want to grow organic traffic.

website-development.q: Can I update the website content myself?
website-development.a: Yes. CMS-based packages let your team edit text, images, blog posts and products without touching code. We include a handover session and a short guide so updating your site takes minutes, not support tickets.

website-development.q: Do you provide hosting and domain?
website-development.a: We can register your .com or .com.my domain and set up fast, secure hosting on your behalf — registered under your ownership, not ours. If you already have hosting, we deploy there instead. Either way, you own everything.

website-development.q: What do I need to prepare before the project starts?
website-development.a: Just three things: your logo and brand assets, the content or bullet points for each page (we help polish the copy), and examples of websites you like. We handle structure, design, copy refinement and everything technical.

website-development.q: Will the website be ready to run ads to?
website-development.a: Yes — every site ships with Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking pre-installed. If you plan to run Google or Meta ads, your website is ad-ready from day one, with WhatsApp click tracking included.

website-development.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
website-development.a: Every project includes 30 days of free post-launch support for bug fixes and small tweaks. After that, optional monthly maintenance covers updates, backups, security and small content changes — or your team can take over fully.

website-development.q: Do you build e-commerce websites for the Malaysian market?
website-development.a: Yes — online stores with local payment gateways (FPX, e-wallets, cards), shipping integrations and product management. We also advise on when a full store makes sense versus starting leaner with a landing page plus WhatsApp ordering.

landing-page-design.q: How much does a landing page cost in Malaysia?
landing-page-design.a: Beriklan's landing page packages start from RM 1,299 — including copywriting, mobile-first design, WhatsApp integration and conversion tracking. The RM 2,999 bundle adds Google Ads setup and first-month management, so you launch page and traffic together.

landing-page-design.q: What is the difference between a landing page and a website?
landing-page-design.a: A website serves many goals and audiences; a landing page has exactly one job — convert visitors from a specific ad into leads or sales. One offer, one message, one call to action. That focus is why landing pages consistently out-convert homepages for paid traffic.

landing-page-design.q: Why do my ads need a dedicated landing page?
landing-page-design.a: Sending paid traffic to a generic homepage is the most common money leak we find in audits. A dedicated page that mirrors the ad's promise typically converts 2–5× better, which directly cuts your cost per lead — often more than any targeting tweak can.

landing-page-design.q: How long does it take to build a landing page?
landing-page-design.a: 7–10 working days from brief to live page, including copywriting, design, WhatsApp integration and tracking setup. If you take the Google Ads bundle, campaigns typically go live within 2 weeks of project start.

Yes — persuasion-focused copy is the core of the service, not an add-on. We research your offer and audience, then write the headline, body and call-to-action structure. You review and approve everything before design begins.

landing-page-design.q: Will the landing page work with WhatsApp?
landing-page-design.a: Yes. Every page ships with WhatsApp click-to-chat buttons carrying pre-filled context messages, plus click tracking — so you know exactly which ad and which page section generated each enquiry.

landing-page-design.q: Do you set up conversion tracking?
landing-page-design.a: Yes — Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion tags and WhatsApp click events are installed and tested before launch. Without proper tracking you cannot optimise; we treat it as part of the build, not an optional extra.

landing-page-design.q: Can you also run the ads to my landing page?
landing-page-design.a: Yes — that is exactly what the RM 2,999 bundle is for: landing page plus Google Ads setup and first-month management in one package. One team owning both page and traffic means faster iteration and cheaper leads.

landing-page-design.q: Can I request changes after the page goes live?
landing-page-design.a: Yes. Two revision rounds are included during the build, plus 30 days of post-launch support. After launch we also recommend small conversion-driven tweaks based on real visitor data — that is where the biggest wins usually come from.

landing-page-design.q: Do landing pages help lower my cost per lead?
landing-page-design.a: Almost always. Because the page matches the ad's promise and removes distractions, conversion rates rise — and since you pay the same for each click, every extra conversion directly lowers your cost per lead. Most clients see the page pay for itself within the first campaign cycles.
